subject: Shortfall on Feb statement — partner commission withheld; VAT treatment & booking
body:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Shortfall on Feb statement — partner commission withheld; VAT treatment & booking

Hi team,

We received the Feb 28 statement and payment from Acme today. Summary: invoice run total EUR 100,000 (invoice IDs: INV-2027-1001 / INV-2027-1002), payment posted to our bank for EUR 97,600. Attached is Acme's remittance advice and our bank trace (ACME_Remittance_20270228.pdf, bank_payment_trace_20270308.csv).

Acme's remittance shows a line labelled "Partner Fee / Commission" of EUR 2,400 deducted at source. They did not include a VAT line against that deduction — the net we received is EUR 97,600.

Questions for finance / policy:
- How should we book the EUR 2,400 deduction? Do we treat it as a contractor/commission expense for Redwood or apply it as a credit against the invoices?
- VAT treatment: Acme did not provide a separate VAT invoice for the deduction. For EU VAT reporting, do we need a credit note from Acme or do we record the VAT adjustment on our side?
- Collections action: should we open a shortfall ticket and request a corrected remittance showing VAT, or is this an allowable contract deduction per the SOW?

Laura — can you confirm the contract language about "partner fee withholdings" (IIRC Schedule B mentions settlement deductions but not commissions). I've attached the relevant clause (Redwood_Agreement_ScheduleB_05122026.pdf).

Karthik — please advise booking entries and whether we should mark these invoices as partially-applied or fully-applied with a contra entry.

I plan to reply to Acme's payments mailbox asking for a formal breakdown and VAT reference; want to align on our ask before we escalate.

Thanks,
Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: payments@acme.com <payments@acme.com>
To: vivek@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 17:48:12 +0000
Subject: Re: Payment for invoices INV-2027-1001 / INV-2027-1002

Vivek,

Please see attached remittance. Payment sent via SEPA on 2027-03-08 (ref 20270308-ACME). Per our partner agreement we withheld a partner fee of EUR 2,400 and netted against your outstanding invoices. No additional VAT was charged on the fee — we treated it as a contractual deduction.

Best,
Acme AP
attachments: ACME_Remittance_20270228.pdf, bank_payment_trace_20270308.csv

-----Reply chain continued-----

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 10:05:33 -0700
Subject: Fw: Payment for invoices INV-2027-1001 / INV-2027-1002

Forwarding Acme's remittance. Quick thoughts:
- We need to determine whether Acme's withholding is permitted under the signed SOW. If not permitted, collections should request the withheld amount and pay the full invoice.
- If permitted, from an accounting standpoint I usually see two options: (1) apply payment net and book the withheld amount as commission/contra-revenue OR (2) mark as unapplied and request a commercial credit note.

Need Karthik's guidance on VAT. If Acme did not charge VAT on the commission and we are in an EU jurisdiction that requires VAT on service fees, we may not be able to self-assess without documentation.

Vanessa

-----Original Message-----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 13:28:54 -0700
Subject: Re: Shortfall on Feb statement — partner commission withheld; VAT treatment & booking

Vivek / Vanessa / Laura,

Accounting recommendation (initial):
1) Book the cash received EUR 97,600 to invoices INV-2027-1001 and INV-2027-1002 pro rata.
2) Create a separate ledger entry for EUR 2,400 labelled "Partner Commission Withheld (Acme)" and post to Commission Expense / Contra-Revenue account depending on final classification. Do not clear the invoices fully with a journal until we have confirmation of contractual allowance.
3) VAT: because Acme did not invoice VAT on the withheld fee, we should request either: (a) a commercial credit note from Acme that shows the fee and VAT (if applicable), or (b) an explicit statement from Acme's tax team that the fee is outside VAT scope. Without that, doing a tax-side adjustment is risky for our EU VAT filings.

Collections action: ask Acme to confirm the legal basis for the withholding and provide a line-level remittance that maps the fee to an invoice or contract clause. If the withholding is not permitted, request immediate payment of the EUR 2,400. If permitted, request a credit note for our records.

I'll prepare the suggested accounting entries and a short collections template.

Karthik

-----Latest Message-----
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: payments@acme.com <payments@acme.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment for invoices INV-2027-1001 / INV-2027-1002

Hi Acme AP,

Thanks for the remittance. We see a net payment of EUR 97,600 against invoices INV-2027-1001 and INV-2027-1002. Your remittance references a "Partner Fee / Commission" deduction of EUR 2,400 but does not include VAT detail or a contractual reference.

Please confirm the following so we can close our ledger:
1) Which contract clause authorizes the EUR 2,400 deduction (please cite schedule and paragraph).
2) Was VAT charged on the commission? If yes, please send the VAT invoice. If not, please confirm in writing the tax/legal basis for treating the fee as non-VATable.
3) Provide a line-level breakdown that maps the deduction to our invoice IDs (INV-2027-1001 / INV-2027-1002) or a separate commission invoice number.

If we do not receive clarification within 5 business days, we will mark the invoices as partially-applied and engage commercial to determine next steps.

Thanks,
Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_Agreement_ScheduleB_05122026.pdf
